items.html: Cecil Marshall's performances in the 1979 ICC Trophy helped Canada qualify for the second World Cup later that summer. His personal highlight in the qualification campaign was against Malaysia, when he top scored with 77 in a match where no one else made a half-century, before taking 3 for 16. After his Canada career, he played cricket and umpired in Ottawa.
